record.category: single-host premium link generator (Vietnamese: Fshare only)

free_tier.stated: 'Get link VIP Fshare, tải nhanh link Fshare tốc độ cao miễn phí không giới hạn' - free and unlimited in the vendor's words, with the caveat printed directly beneath: 'Hiện tại Get link Fshare đang bảo trì, tỉ lệ thành công ngẫu nhiên' (under maintenance, success rate random).
free_tier.notes: No account, no price, no quota: the only stated condition is a random success rate.

retention.stated: not applicable: a direct link is returned

egress.terms: No published allowance. The mechanism is URL rewriting: 'Thay thế www.fshare.vn thành getlinkfshare.com', so the free path inherits whatever Fshare's own free-account shaping does.

record.interface_detail: Host-substitution: replace the fshare.vn domain with getlinkfshare.com and keep the /file/<id> path.
record.tooling: Any browser; the rewritten URL is a plain HTTP link.
record.chaining: The cheapest possible entry to Fshare and the least reliable: no account, no fee, no quota, and a vendor-admitted random success rate. Useful as a fallback in a queue that already has a paid path.

limits.value: unstated; the vendor states a random success rate rather than a limit

record.limits_note: No numeric cap exists to record. The failure mode is a refused get, not a quota error.
record.binding_note: Nothing measurable binds because nothing is quantified; the constraint is the vendor's own admission that success is random.

identity_cost.detail: No signup, no payment, no email: the URL rewrite needs nothing. This is the one Vietnamese Fshare path that a foreigner can use without any identity at all.

record.reliability_note: Vendor states the service is under maintenance with a random success rate; an unquantified success rate is the whole reliability story, and there is no support channel to ask.
record.confidence_note: One page read on 2026-10-23; the maintenance sentence is the vendor's own. Measuring the success rate would need a batch of Fshare links, which on 2026-10-23 did not have.

evidence.proved: 'Get link VIP Fshare, tải nhanh link Fshare tốc độ cao miễn phí không giới hạn'; 'Hiện tại Get link Fshare đang bảo trì, tỉ lệ thành công ngẫu nhiên'; domain-substitution instructions
third-party description of the same rewrite workflow, and that the page accepted only 'https://www.fshare.vn/file/xxx' shaped links

record.notes: Included because the sector needs a zero-identity baseline against which the paid shops can be judged: free, anonymous, and explicitly unreliable. Trigger condition: the rewrite stops working twice in a row on a real link.
